basic_details.job_title: NIT Kurukshetra Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: B.Tech (Second year onwards) / M.Tech student of NIT Kurukshetra from Computer Engineering / Electronics & Communication / Electrical Engineering, with minimum aggregate First Class / CGPA 6.5 and experience of working on projects in IOT/AI/ML or Drone Application Development or another field relevant to Unmanned Aerial Systems.
qualification.details: Qualification: B.Tech (Second year onwards) / M.Tech Student of NIT Kurukshetra from Computer Engineering / Electronics & Communication / Electrical engineering, with experience of working on projects in IOT/AI/ML or Drone Application Development or any other field relevant to Unmanned Aerial Systems; aggregate First Class/CGPA 6.5 Experience: Experience of working on projects in IOT/AI/ML or Drone Application Development or any other field relevant to Unmanned Aerial Systems | Other conditions: | Only candidates with minimum aggregate First Class/CGPA 6.5 in B.E./B.Tech. (up to last semester) or M.E./M.Tech. (with First class in preceding examination) can apply.

how_to_apply: Get the application form from the Institute website http://www.nitkkr.ac.in (also printed on page 2 of the notice).
Fill and sign the application form.
Attach self-attested scanned B.Tech/M.Tech mark-sheets of all semesters, relevant experience certificates and necessary documents.
Combine everything in a single PDF file.
Email it to [email protected] on or before 2nd Dec, 2026 with the subject "Application for the post of Research Fellow".
important_instructions: The applicant has to ensure the authenticity of information provided in support of experience, other documents and photograph. The Institute may relax qualification and experience at any point of time for otherwise exceptional candidates.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: B.Tech (Second year onwards) / M.Tech Student of NIT Kurukshetra from Computer Engineering / Electronics & Communication / Electrical engineering, with experience of working on projects in IOT/AI/ML or Drone Application Development or any other field relevant to Unmanned Aerial Systems; aggregate First Class/CGPA 6.5 Experience: Experience of working on projects in IOT/AI/ML or Drone Application Development or any other field relevant to Unmanned Aerial Systems Other conditions: Only candidates with minimum aggregate First Class/CGPA 6.5 in B.E./B.Tech. (up to last semester) or M.E./M.Tech. (with First class in preceding examination) can apply.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for NIT Kurukshetra Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications received after the last date will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely contractual for 10 months, reviewed after every 2 months.

content_sections.heading: How Will NIT Kurukshetra Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of applications Interview/Test for shortlisted candidates List of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on the institute website on 3rd Dec, 2026. Interview/Test for shortlisted candidates on 4th Dec, 2026; final date/venue will be communicated in the intimation email.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Duly filled and signed application form with self-attested photograph Self-attested scanned B.Tech/M.Tech mark-sheets of all semesters Relevant experience certificates Photocopies of certificates/DMCs for the educational qualifications Other necessary documents

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Kurukshetra Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Get the application form from the Institute website http://www.nitkkr.ac.in (also printed on page 2 of the notice). Fill and sign the application form. Attach self-attested scanned B.Tech/M.Tech mark-sheets of all semesters, relevant experience certificates and necessary documents. Combine everything in a single PDF file. Email it to [email protected] on or before 2nd Dec, 2026 with the subject "Application for the post of Research Fellow".

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: The applicant has to ensure the authenticity of information provided in support of experience, other documents and photograph. The Institute may relax qualification and experience at any point of time for otherwise exceptional candidates.
